Description:
Vizualize, analyze and explore networks using Cytoscape
via R. Anything you can do using the graphical user interface
of Cytoscape, you can now do with a single RCy3 function.
Config/pak/sysreqs:
make libicu-dev libxml2-dev libssl-dev python3
libzmq3-dev
